I am too old to carry heavy fertilizer bags on this rented land, so I will save my small money and not buy chemicals. I will plant cassava cuttings from my own harvest last season and spread goat manure around the mounds to keep the soil strong. Here in the South South the rains come well, so I do not need irrigation, and cassava does not suffer much from pests. My children and grandchildren will help me with the planting and weeding, so we will not hire any outside workers.
